title: Cointegrated Regressors: Where Folded Concave Penalties Go Beyond LASSO
abstract: arXiv:2610.14617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LASSO is one of the most popular regularization methods for high-dimensional regression models. While cointegration is common in practical applications of predictive regressions with many regressors, the convex penalty of LASSO overly suppresses the coefficients of cointegrated regressors and therefore fails to deliver consistent parameter estimation. We employ folded concave penalties (FCP), including the well-known SCAD and MCP, to address this issue. Using FCP, we establish two asymptotic results: (i) a local oracle property for the penalized regression, and (ii) a global oracle property for regressions with a penalty-level constraint. In particular, the latter guarantees a global solution that consistently estimates the true coefficients and enjoys oracle prediction performance. Simulation studies and an application to predicting the euro area unemployment rate show that FCP improves variable selection and out-of-sample prediction

translated_title: 协整回归变量：折叠凹惩罚超越LASSO之处
translated_abstract: LASSO是高维回归模型中最流行的正则化方法之一。然而，在包含大量回归变量的预测回归的实际应用中，协整关系十分常见，而LASSO的凸惩罚会过度压缩协整回归变量的系数，因此无法实现一致的参数估计。本文采用折叠凹惩罚（FCP），包括著名的SCAD和MCP，来解决这一问题。基于FCP，我们建立了两个渐近结果：(i) 惩罚回归的局部oracle性质，以及 (ii) 带有惩罚水平约束的回归的全局oracle性质。特别是，后者保证了一个全局解，该解能够一致地估计真实系数并具备oracle预测性能。模拟研究以及预测欧元区失业率的实际应用表明，FCP在变量选择和样本外预测方面均有改进。
tldr: 针对LASSO凸惩罚过度压缩协整回归变量系数而导致参数估计不一致的问题，本文采用折叠凹惩罚（SCAD和MCP）建立了局部与全局oracle性质，证明其能一致估计真实系数并显著改善变量选择和样本外预测效果。
en_tdlr: To overcome LASSO's convex penalty over-shrinking the coefficients of cointegrated regressors and failing to deliver consistent estimation, this paper employs folded concave penalties (SCAD and MCP) to establish local and global oracle properties, demonstrating consistent coefficient estimation and improved variable selection and out-of-sample prediction.
